text_block_list.text:
Possessing outstanding physical 
capabilities, Maruzensky was already 
drawing immense attention before her 
debut, earning the nickname "Supercar."

Adored by her juniors and often seen as 
someone to look up to, she set her sights 
on an even higher stage.

From here, the challenge towards the 
Twinkle Series with Maruzensky began.
